result.topic_en: Hilbert discusses when a system of partial differential equations (including a Jacobian-type determinant condition) is genuinely determined, proposes finding a general criterion for this, and then sketches a plan to prove his independence theorem in the calculus of variations by deriving a partial differential equation for the minimum as a function of the endpoint.
